title: Application Gateway WAF and Routing
description: Explore Web Application Firewall policies and advanced routing features in Application Gateway.

data.text: The Web Application Firewall (WAF) on Application Gateway protects your apps from common exploits like SQL injection and cross-site scripting. WAF uses the OWASP Core Rule Set to inspect incoming requests.
Advanced routing includes rewrite rules, redirection, and custom probes. You can configure these through the Azure Portal, Bicep, or Terraform.

data.title: WAF Protection Modes
items: Detection — logs threats but does not block them
Prevention — blocks threats and logs them

data.title: Enable WAF on Application Gateway
data.content: Update an Application Gateway to enable WAF with prevention mode.
data.code: az network application-gateway waf-config set   --name myAppGw   --resource-group myRG   --enabled true   --firewall-mode Prevention   --rule-set-type OWASP   --rule-set-version 3.2

data.title: Redirect HTTP to HTTPS
data.content: Create a redirect configuration on Application Gateway.
data.code:
az network application-gateway http-listener create   --name http-listener   --resource-group myRG   --gateway-name myAppGw   --frontend-ip-name appGwFrontendIP   --frontend-port-name appGwFrontendPortHttp   --protocol Http

az network application-gateway redirect-config create   --name redirect-to-https   --resource-group myRG   --gateway-name myAppGw   --target-listener https-listener   --type Permanent   --include-path true   --include-query-string true

data.title: Configure WAF and Redirect
data.description: Enable WAF on an Application Gateway and configure HTTP-to-HTTPS redirection.
steps: Enable WAF on your Application Gateway in Prevention mode.
Create a redirect configuration from HTTP to HTTPS.
Test a request with a SQL injection payload and verify it is blocked.
data.expectedOutcome: HTTP requests are redirected to HTTPS and malicious payloads are blocked by WAF.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: WAF protects against OWASP Top 10 vulnerabilities.
Prevention mode blocks attacks; Detection mode logs them.
Application Gateway v2 supports per-site WAF policies and availability zones.
data.takeaway: Enable WAF on any internet-facing Application Gateway. It is a critical layer of defense.
